colors.archetype_instruction: Use True Black for canvas. Warm-biased white for text to emulate clinical phosphor feel. Neon cyan/green for highlights.

grids_and_layouts.page_structure: Mode B: High Density Grid. Use sharp geometric slates framed by sharp 1px division rails.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 inside major structural panels to let data breathe.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align complex data for readability. Central alignment only for the initial massive search input.
grids_and_layouts.progressive_disclosure: Keep high-level scores visible immediately. Hide detailed tabular data or deep mechanisms in framer-motion accordions or tabs.

component_guidelines.hero_search: Massive central input using Tracing Beam border effect. Minimalist glassmorphism backdrop.
component_guidelines.topic_tabs: Clean underline or pill-based tabs. No bulky standard buttons. Smooth framer-motion indicator.
component_guidelines.score_gauge: 0-100 Science Score as a glowing radial progress ring. Neon color coding (0-40 Red, 40-70 Yellow, 70-100 Green/Cyan).
component_guidelines.evidence_badges: 1px solid border matching the safety color. High-contrast dot or icon inside.
component_guidelines.cards_and_panels: Flat instrument-panel switches. No elevation drop shadows. Use 1px hairlines (border-white/10).
component_guidelines.ask_apexbio_panel: Floating sidebar or bottom-right glassmorphic panel (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/5, border border-white/10).
component_guidelines.body_system_vis: Use an anatomy image overlay with absolutely positioned glowing cyan indicator dots (or framer-motion ping effects) pointing to affected organs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. border-r border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky elements (Ask ApexBio, Top Nav). High blur (backdrop-blur-2xl), subtle 1px top border.
visual_enhancers.motion: Use framer-motion for tab content switching, gauge fill animations, and search focus states. Staggered fade-ins for metric grids.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 for standard text. Use text-shadow if layering over abstract visuals.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons and tabs must have clear focus-visible states (ring-1 ring-cyan-500) and hover states (bg-white/5).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or regular weight for clinical precision)

images.description: Use in the Explore or Topic details for muscular/tissue-level visualization
Background aesthetic or hero visual texture for the search page (use with low opacity)

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion combined with high-quality PNGs or Recharts for complex data. R3F is optional but might slow down heavy dashboards. For metrics, Recharts inside flat panels is preferred.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, recharts, clsx, tailwind-merge, lucide-react.
Ensure dark mode is fully set up in tailwind.config.js and index.css with True Black (#000000) canvas and #0A0A0A surface layers.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn card components out-of-the-box. Strip the drop shadows and use strict 1px border-white/10.
Implement the 'Ask ApexBio' conversational follow-up as a sleek sliding panel or persistent side widget.
For the body system visualization, use the provided anatomical image as a background and overlay interactive dot markers using framer-motion.
Ensure the learning-level toggle (Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced) visually updates the density of the information on the page.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Create depth through border hairlines and typography opacity rather than muddy drop shadows.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays. Use solid or blurred backgrounds.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use proper vector icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings, scale on click).
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Favor precision over standard SaaS aesthetics, focusing on high data-ink ratios and clinical, instrument-like interfaces.
Ensure perceptual uniformity. Use color scales that map logically to data intensity.
Enforce typography tabular-nums for real-time or score data to prevent jitter.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
